CareersAndJobGuideClient_s03.t01: How to actually get a reply
CareersAndJobGuideClient_s03.t02: A polished profile gets you noticed. These are the tactics that get you a reply once you've reached out.
CareersAndJobGuideClient_s03.t04: A 20-second personalised voice note can push reply rates from 30% up to 75%.
CareersAndJobGuideClient_s03.t06: A problem statement plus a 45-second Loom video on how you can help gets 3x the click-through of text alone, and roughly 1 in 3 viewers book a call.
CareersAndJobGuideClient_s03.t08: A well-placed, personalised meme or bit of humour after a couple of unanswered follow-ups can be exactly the pattern-interrupt that finally gets a reply.
CareersAndJobGuideClient_s03.t10: It's not just what you send, it's when. Hitting someone's "morning scroll window," coffee, commute, or meeting prep, instead of just whenever you're free, can roughly double reply rates.
